rig_anchor.note: [SIMULATION; endpoints resampled from rig windows, 1 bearing/fault, curve shape assumed] No real run-to-failure data exists for 4 of 5 fault classes. Anchors = 5 physical bearings (H-01 + one per fault); test units are held-out simulated trajectories, not held-out bearings; the damage-curve family is assumed. Registered before any model is fitted; test scored once.
rig_anchor.policy: aiengine.rig_anchor.generator.plan_units (deterministic enumeration; balanced over 5 classes and speeds; ball only 1800); pool windows split by TIME BLOCKS inside each real run: train first 60 %, val next 20 %, test last 20 % (after the settle drop); units of split S use ONLY pool-S windows; test shape parameters drawn from a WIDER range than train (shape OOD)

rig_anchor_test2.note: [SIMULATION; endpoints resampled from rig windows, 1 bearing/fault, curve shape assumed] No real run-to-failure data exists for 4 of 5 fault classes. Anchors = 5 physical bearings (H-01 + one per fault); test units are held-out simulated trajectories, not held-out bearings; the damage-curve family is assumed. Registered before any v6 model is fitted; the fresh test units are scored once.
rig_anchor_test2.policy: FRESH test units for v6_node (ids u1000-u1079), drawn only from the TEST pool blocks of rig_anchor.pools (last 20 % of each real run, the SAME real windows as the v5 test units); same shape OOD ranges as the registered rig_anchor test split; new per-unit seeds via new unit ids. NOT new bearings. Extra train units u2000-u2399 from the train pool blocks. control_wrong_shape: u3000-u3079.

rig_real.note: [MEASURED on rig] registered before fitting by train_real; data ../COE/training/training_data
